title: VirSME Workflows | Connect Business Processes End to End
description: See how VirSME connects records, people, rules, approvals and modules around complete business workflows.
hero: Stop managing one business process as five separate administrative jobs.
intro: VirSME workflows connect records, people, modules, rules and approvals around one business outcome.

blocks.text: Hiring can trigger employee setup, manager assignment, documents, policies, access, training, work allocation, payroll-related steps, notifications and review milestones.
A won opportunity can carry customer context, scope, promises, ownership and next actions into delivery without a manual reset.
A request can be identified, routed through the applicable SOP, prepared by AI, authorized where required and completed with an audit trail.
Policies, thresholds and authority rules determine who should approve what, while the workflow keeps the context attached.
Your workflow is the starting point
Bring the process that currently depends on spreadsheets, email, WhatsApp, repeated data entry or staff memory.
